ideas.pitch: A hybrid classical-quantum semantic router that offloads embedding classification tasks to Qiskit-simulated parameterized quantum circuits, improving routing accuracy on ambiguous intents.
ideas.title: QDiff-Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages Qiskit for a practical hybrid system, matching the sponsor's focus on hybrid classical-quantum computing applications.

ideas.pitch: An automated Variational Quantum Eigensolver optimizer that uses reinforcement learning to dynamically adjust ansatz parameters and reduce gate depth for molecular simulation.
ideas.title: VQE-Chain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles genuine hard engineering in quantum simulation and optimization, appealing directly to researchers and judges evaluating technical depth in Qiskit.

ideas.pitch: A quantum neural network classifier designed to detect adversarial perturbations in classical financial datasets using parameterized quantum circuits.
ideas.title: QML-Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases Quantum Machine Learning (QML) and Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs), aligning perfectly with the core technical domains highlighted in the event description.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous debugging agent that analyzes Qiskit circuit compilation errors, diagnoses gate-fidelity bottlenecks, and automatically applies transpiler optimization passes.
ideas.title: CircuitMetrics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a persistent, painful problem for developers building with Qiskit during the hackathon, directly addressing the judges' familiarity with the tooling.

ideas.pitch: A simulation toolkit for distributing entanglement across multi-node quantum networks using Qiskit protocols and classical message passing.
ideas.title: EntangleNet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on advanced quantum networking concepts, offering an impressive visual and architectural demonstration for the final presentations.
